notes.title: Big Update!!
notes.content:
Major Update Notes:

- Battery Capacity Increased: Battery capacity has been doubled, allowing for longer exploration time!

- Graphics Improved: Visuals and environmental details have been enhanced for a better experience.

- Chapter 3 Completely Reworked: The entire third chapter has been renewed with clearer storytelling and new scenes.

- New Story Additions: Fresh narrative elements have been added to enrich the game's lore.

- Animations and Sounds Updated: More realistic animations and revamped sound effects improve the overall atmosphere.

- Critical Bugs Fixed: Major bugs affecting gameplay progression have been resolved.

- Battery Drain Balanced: Battery consumption rate has been adjusted for better gameplay balance.

- Unused Objects Removed: Unnecessary objects have been cleared to improve performance.

- Optimization Performed: Extensive optimization for smoother gameplay and increased FPS.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix Update – 8.06.2025

- Crash issue in the first level has been completely fixed.
- Several bug fixes implemented.
- Minor new features and improvements added.

Your feedback is always appreciated. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Major Update – New Models, Structures & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Update Notes:

- Creepy Doll model has been redesigned.

- New structures and horror figures have been added.

- Various sound improvements.

- Dynamic Depth of Field feature implemented.

- Crash issue in the first scene fixed.

- Lighting completely revamped.

- General bug fixes applied.

- UI updated and improved.

notes.title: Minor Update Notes
notes.content:
The darkness just got a little deeper...


- Bug Fixes
Several annoying bugs have been squashed. Now the shadows can follow you more smoothly...

- Jumpscare Tweaks
Some jumpscares have been reworked. Expect to be caught off guard more often.

- New Sound Details
New sound effects have been added to enhance the atmosphere and tension.

- Updated Loading Screen
The loading screen has been redesigned — even waiting should feel unsettling now.

- Improved Head Movement
More realistic and unsettling head/camera movements to increase immersion and discomfort.

- New Small Details
New hidden clues and small details have been added to make exploration more intriguing (and terrifying).

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hotfix Update

- Bug Fixes: Several critical bugs and crash issues have been resolved.

- Performance Improvements: General game performance optimized for a smoother experience.

- Other Improvements: Minor UI glitches and visual issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Minor Update

- Aim Added
Aiming mechanics have been added for the first time, giving players greater precision while aiming.

- Dot Sight Added
A dot sight is now available for more accurate targeting, helping players line up shots with ease.

- Crosshair Customization Added
Players can now customize their crosshair to better suit their playstyle.

- Updated Jumpscares
Several jumpscares have been revamped with enhanced visuals and sounds for a scarier experience.

- UI Improvements
The user interface has been updated for better clarity and to match the game’s atmosphere.

- "Undead Waves" Difficulty Increased
Surviving the undead is now even more challenging with tougher enemies and increased intensity.

- Battery Difficulty Adjusted
Managing your flashlight battery now requires more strategic planning.

- Bug Fixes
Various bugs have been addressed to improve stability and performance.

notes.title: Latest Update: Undead Waves, Microphone Settings, and Optimizations!
notes.content:
New Update!

- Various Scene Adjustments Made! Continue exploring with new details.

- New Game Mode - Undead Waves: Try to survive against terrifying waves of zombie-like creatures!

- Microphone On/Off Setting: A new option to toggle the microphone on or off has been added, making your experience more personal.

- Optimization Improvements: Performance enhancements and optimizations have been made for smoother gameplay.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The Rot Awakes - New Update
notes.content:
Horror Update - "The Rot Awakes"

• New Enemy: Creepy Doll
The terrifying Creepy Doll now appears in abandoned rooms. If you hear her… it might already be too late.

• New Mutant: The Bloated Rot
Rotten, swollen, and deadly… The Bloated Rot now lurks in the swamps, waiting to strike.

• Various Improvements and Additions
Atmosphere enhanced with new visual and sound effects. Minor bugs fixed.

• First Chapter Made Easier
The first chapter is now more balanced for new players. Surviving the nightmare is a bit easier… for now.

notes.title: Major Update: Storyline Changes, Realistic Weapon Animations
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

• Storyline Changes: Several important changes and improvements have been made to the game's storyline.
• Weapon Animations Improved: Weapon animations have been enhanced to be more realistic.
• Recoil Enhancements: The recoil movement of weapons has been updated for a more realistic experience.
• Bug Fixes: Various minor bugs have been fixed.
• Running Feature Added for Chapter 2: The running mechanic has been added for Chapter 2.

notes.title: New Update: Enhanced Realism and New Features
notes.content:
Update Notes:

• Head Movements: Head movements have been made more realistic, providing a more natural experience for the player.
• Weapon Animations: Weapon animations have been improved and made smoother.
• Flashlight: The flashlight's color has been changed, enhancing the visual experience.
• Bug Fixes: Many small bugs have been fixed, improving game performance.
• Scene Improvements: Scene adjustments have been made, and the quality of visuals has been enhanced.
• New Feature: A screenshot feature has been added with the F4 key!
• Bell Sound: A sound has been added when approaching the bells, making it easier to locate them.

notes.title: Update Notes: Candle Mechanic, Bug Fixes, and Sound Improvements
notes.content:
Hello Dark Shadows players,

- New Feature: Added a candle mechanic to mark paths using the 'Q' key. (Only for the first chapter)
- Bug Fixes: Fixed various in-game bugs and improved mechanics.
- Sound Updates: Updated and optimized sound effects for a better experience.
- Intro Skip: Intro skip feature has been added with the 'Space' key.

Beware of Dark Shadow!
